Benefits of L-Tyrosine With Adderall Overview
After having really great results from taking L-tyrosine, I feel the need to share this information because it may hopefully benefit someone else. Im a 20 year old, 510 150 lb male and I have been taking amphetamines (Adderall) infrequently for about the past two years. I use it around exam times and occasionally for recreation. Now, Adderall can be great but it used to be very unpredictable for me in the side effects I would get. Sometimes everything would be great and I would thoroughly enjoy it, and yet other times I have felt nervous, anxious, emotionally unstable or numb (which bothered be more than anything), and of course theres the crash. The crash would often make me feel really down and lethargic, which would made me regret that I had taken the stuff in the first place.
However, a few months ago I discovered L-Tyrosine, the amino acid that is supposed to boost natural dopamine levels. Now I have never been diagnosed for ADD, but I do believe that I have it to some extent, or at least a dopamine deficiency.  But all I know is that when I started taking the Tyrosine, I was blown away by how much this stuff helped me. The first time I took it, it felt like I had taken a low dose of Adderall, only much smoother and with no side effects. After taking it for a week or so daily at a dose of 1000 mg each morning, I realized how much more focused, productive, and confident I had become. Also, my thinking became a lot clearer, and I have more energy it seems than I did before.
Here is the best part though. I realized that since I have been taking tyrosine, I now have absolutely no negative side effects when I take Adderall
, it makes the Adderall feel incredibly smooth every time. As far as crashing goes, its not existent. Once the amphetamines peak, I still feel confident and comfortable on the pleasant ride back to normal. I also dont feel a craving for more Adderall when it wears off, which I used to experience often.  And when I am on the Adderall, I still feel like I can connect with other people and my emotions are completely stable. I don't feel forced to be overly speedy or talkative, though I could still talk for hours about anything and everything if I wanted; I just don't feel like I HAVE to. With the tyrosine, Adderall still leaves me feeling in complete control of myself and my emotions, which is great.
I now take tyrosine 1-2 times a week, usually at a dose of 500 mg. It has helped me a lot, and I have yet to experience anything negative from it.  I dont take Adderall very often, but when I do, it is nothing but pleasant outside perhaps an elevated heart rate, but even that is much less prevalent than it used to be. I cant speak for anyone else, but the Tyrosine has done wonders for me.
I think it is also important to note that tyrosine has improved the way other substances affect me as well, not just Adderall. I smoke cannabis occasionally and it gives me a much more focusable and less foggy high than it used to. Caffeine even works better and the side effects I used to get from it are pretty much gone now. So thats my two cents.  I have found tyrosine and Adderall to have wonderful synergy.
